utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that if you tell me what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I need a few supplies first, mostly parts and tools. I can write down the list if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, please write it down and I’ll help sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we need to make sure the timing and parts are lined up first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the parts will be here before we set a time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I don’t want us to set a time until the parts are definitely on hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might've missed the latest update, but I'm listening now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I think I remember now. I’ll tell you what I know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, tell me what you know about it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll tell Ira we’re still on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late — what's left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly cleanup and small fixes now. If you can grab the paint supplies, that’ll help us finish faster.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll grab the paint supplies now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Morning, Eli. The porch light’s flickering, the screen door sticks, and there’s a loose step by the front walk. I’d love you here around 2 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Two o’clock works for me. I’ll come by then and we’ll take them one at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the loose rail on the porch and a couple of steps by the side gate. I can show you where it’s wobbling.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Show me the side gate steps first, and I’ll take a look at the rail after that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. I can check with the other folks and make sure we’ve got everything covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d help a lot, Jules. I’ve been keeping track of the supplies at the community shed, and I can let you know if anything’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks. I’ll check in with the others and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that. I’ll check with a few neighbors and make sure we’ve got the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll keep at it and let you know once I’ve checked with them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we still need for the repair drive and set it aside.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. Just let me know what’s still missing and I’ll help gather it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the list again and let you know exactly what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s moving along, but a few folks still need parts before they can wrap up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like they’re close. I hope the last few parts show up soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I’m hearing too. If the parts come in today, they should be able to finish it up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me exactly what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s mostly the usual stuff: a broken hinge on the side gate, a loose step on the porch, and the front door latch needs tightening. I can send you the full list if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I just need help getting the repair supplies picked up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll pick up the supplies. Where should I grab them from?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help keep folks posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll keep people in the loop and let them know you’re on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I missed what changed, but I can help if you remind me what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can remind you after I catch my breath. It’s for the repair drive at the community hall, and I’m trying to keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it. Just point me to what needs fixing, and I’ll help keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. I can help out if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey. I could use a hand with the repairs, especially any tools you can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll bring over some tools and help with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Opal. I’m keeping the repair drive list organized, and I’ll make sure we have the supplies and volunteers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I can keep track of the locations and help if you need anything sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, then we’re set. I’ll keep the list tight and let you know which locations still need coverage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we start, can we make sure the repair drive has a clear time and place? I need to know how to plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, let’s pin down the time and exact spot first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive for the neighborhood tools, right? Just confirming before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, the neighborhood tools repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, that’s the one. I just wanted to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for it, Dane. Tell me what’s being fixed first and when you’re starting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m starting with the plumbing and outlets first, then I’ll move to the trim work. I’m coming by tomorrow morning to get it underway.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll be ready tomorrow morning and we can start with the plumbing and outlets first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m still catching up. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s happening this week, and I’m keeping an eye on supplies. If you know anyone who can donate tools or spare parts, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word and see if I can find anyone with extra tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was just thinking about it a minute ago - remind me what part I was supposed to handle?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You were going to handle the tool table and I’d cover the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the tool table. I’ve got that - thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, if Leo can swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works for me. I'll swing by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you after pickup.
